name: llm-unit-test
description: Using llm to generate unit test and analyzation for user

llmUnitTest.outputPath.description: 測試結果輸出資料夾路徑

llmUnitTest.language.description: UI and output language (auto will follow VS Code language)

llmUnitTest.promptStrategy.description: Prompt strategy: small (strict formatting) vs large (advanced reasoning)

llmUnitTest.pythonPath.description: Optional Python interpreter. When empty, the workspace .venv interpreter is used if available; otherwise PATH python is used for AST, trace, coverage, and mutation commands

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
